text_block_list.text:
Her second Arima Kinen had finally 
arrived.

Just as I was about to see her off—at that 
very moment.

A sharp, unmistakable tension filled the 
air. When I turned around—she was there.

With an aura that seemed to demand 
everyone make way, Symboli Rudolf strode 
down the underground paddock tunnel.

Intimidated by that imposing aura, the 
surrounding Umamusume quickly scrambled 
out of the way.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
(A long time has passed. We've both 
changed in so many ways—and we've even 
taken on things to carry on our 
shoulders.)

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
(...But it's not over yet. The journey is 
long.)

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
(—Let's settle the score once and for all 
right here.)

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Let's see which of us is stronger, you or 
me...!

With burning eyes, Sirius Symboli glared 
at her back.
The Arima Kinen is about to begin.
